concept_units: The jacket extends broadly across the shoulders.
its roomy sleeves and torso share the same enlarged proportions.

applicability.reason: scope compatible; scene and aesthetic interpretation pending

rejections.reason: The complete candidate describes one oversized jacket across shoulders, sleeves, and torso. The independently frozen case is a dress upper-panel/sleeve/neckline study. Translating jacket into dress would evade its declared carrier; adding the jacket over the dress would conceal the targeted dress endpoints. A jacket is not a requester exclusion. It is an eligible open choice that is declined because it does not serve this independent case.

claim_limit: Exposure is established, but no suitable new fit data was adopted; a later baseline image cannot establish a new-data pixel effect.
